summary.en: The five Platonic solids (tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron and icosahedron), one by one or as a set, sized by edge or by the sphere around them and unfolded into tabbed, numbered card nets on pages, with a program that folds each net ring by ring into its solid.
summary.es: Los cinco sólidos platónicos (tetraedro, cubo, octaedro, dodecaedro e icosaedro), uno por uno o en juego, medidos por la arista o por la esfera que los rodea y desplegados en plantillas de cartulina con pestañas y aristas numeradas, sobre hojas, con una secuencia que dobla cada plantilla, anillo por anillo, hasta cerrar su sólido.
summary.fr: Les cinq solides de Platon (tétraèdre, cube, octaèdre, dodécaèdre et icosaèdre), un par un ou en jeu, dimensionnés par l'arête ou par la sphère qui les entoure et dépliés en patrons de bristol à languettes et arêtes numérotées, sur des pages, avec un programme qui plie chaque patron, couronne par couronne, jusqu'à son solide.
summary.pt: Os cinco sólidos platônicos (tetraedro, cubo, octaedro, dodecaedro e icosaedro), um a um ou em conjunto, medidos pela aresta ou pela esfera que os envolve e desdobrados em moldes de cartolina com abas e arestas numeradas, em folhas, com uma sequência que dobra cada molde, anel por anel, até fechar o sólido.

era: classical geometry (Plato, Euclid); first printed nets 1525 (Dürer)
excludes: Dürer's printed nets and any textbook or template net: every net is generated by pliego.unfold
Printed artwork on the faces: the colours are the studio's; on paper the colour is the card
Archimedean, Kepler–Poinsot and other non-Platonic polyhedra (see papercraft-unfold for any mesh)
sources: Euclid, Elements, Book XIII; T. L. Heath (trans.), The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements, vol. 3, Cambridge University Press, 1908
A. Dürer, Underweysung der Messung mit dem Zirckel und Richtscheyt, Nuremberg, 1525
E. D. Demaine, J. O'Rourke, Geometric Folding Algorithms: Linkages, Origami, Polyhedra, Cambridge University Press, 2007
F. Buekenhout, M. Parker, The number of nets of the regular convex polytopes in dimension ≤ 4, Discrete Mathematics 186 (1998)
W. Schlickenrieder, Nets of Polyhedra, diploma thesis, TU Berlin, 1997
